ruleName: No hardcoded secrets — use appsettings + IOptions + user-secrets / Key Vault
suggestedFix: Move the literal to an IOptions<T>-bound config section in appsettings.json with a placeholder value. Real value goes to user-secrets (dev) or Key Vault (prod). Never commit the real value.
